name: Orlando Sentinel editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Orlando Sentinel Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). Under a 2022 Tribune Publishing policy it no longer endorses for president, governor or U.S. Senate. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/orlando-sentinel-media-bias.

name: South Florida Sun Sentinel editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Sun Sentinel Center. Sister paper of the Orlando Sentinel (same Alden ownership and the same 2022 no-endorsement policy for president, governor and Senate); its amendment editorials were co-published with the Sentinel. Included because its 'just say no to all three' editorial is one of the newspaper positions on the amendments. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/sun-sentinel-media-bias.

name: Miami Herald editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Miami Herald Lean Left (checked Oct. 2026). No separate editorial-board rating was found. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/miami-herald-media-bias.

name: Tampa Bay Times editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Tampa Bay Times Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026), and Ad Fontes rates it Middle (-3.28). It is owned by the nonprofit Poynter Institute. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/tampa-bay-times-media-bias.

name: TCPalm / Treasure Coast Newspapers editorial board
lean_basis: Not rated. The existing record contains no quoted ideological mission or usable outside rating. Its source: https://www.tcpalm.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/10/14/florida-amendment-3-endorsement-recommendation-how-vote-opinion/92242024007/.

name: Tallahassee Democrat
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Tallahassee Democrat Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). The Gannett paper is not among those offering 2026 recommendations. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/tallahassee-democrat-media-bias.

name: Pensacola News Journal
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Pensacola News Journal Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). The Gannett paper is not among those offering 2026 recommendations. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/pensacola-news-journal-media-bias.

name: League of Women Voters of Florida (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters state chapter that calls itself 'a nonpartisan, activist, grassroots organization that believes voters should play a critical role in democracy' (https://lwvfl.org/about-us/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Florida TaxWatch
lean_basis: Its own description says it is nonpartisan or takes no side: "independent, nonpartisan, nonprofit taxpayer research institute and government watchdog". Source: https://www.floridataxwatch.org/about-florida-taxwatch/about/.

name: Florida Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; backs its general-election nominees and opposes Amendment 3.

name: Republican Party of Florida
lean_basis: Official state party organization; backs its general-election nominees and supports Amendments 1 and 3.

name: Florida AFL-CIO
lean_basis: State labor federation that says 'We work to provide better lives for all workers, members or not, through political and legislative action, grassroots mobilization and education' (https://flaflcio.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Florida Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Statewide business lobby that says it has been 'fighting for greater economic opportunity and job creation since 1916' (https://www.flchamber.com/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: NRA Political Victory Fund
lean_basis: Gun-rights PAC of the National Rifle Association, which calls itself 'a single issue organization' that grades candidates on 'Second Amendment issues' (https://www.nrapvf.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Florida Sheriffs Association
lean_basis: Association of Florida's 67 elected sheriffs; it does not endorse as an association. Its About page (https://www.flsheriffs.org/about) lists services and states no ideological mission, so under this guide's rule for law enforcement groups it is neutral. No outside rating found.

name: Florida Education Association
lean_basis: Statewide teachers' union that calls itself 'the largest labor union in the Southeast' (https://feaweb.org/about-fea/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Florida Realtors
lean_basis: Real estate trade group that calls itself 'the state's largest trade association' (https://www.floridarealtors.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
